verdict.rationale: RustDesk is a remote desktop product with a management API in Server Pro, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment. Users could self-host a separate OSS server as a test instance, but that is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
